note: Task(...) scopes equal Agent(...) scopes; a definition naming Task resolves to Agent; denying Agent or Task removes both launchers. A Task call with a description and no Cursor persona or Cursor-only field runs the Agent contract; Cursor-shaped Task calls keep the Cursor contract. Task stays in the registered tool list (init analog).

Offered name carries the recovered description and the ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$ pattern (team profile only, see A15). Internal schema leaves the pattern to admission so internal callers get the recovered refusal messages.
Internal contract accepts an absolute cwd from a tool_call input rewrite (the pi analog of the agent.spawn hook); relative cwd refused with 'cwd must be an absolute path: <cwd>'. Never offered.
Reachable now: an internal cwd plus isolation worktree is refused before any child starts.

Default offer is exactly description,prompt,subagent_type,model,run_in_background,isolation with the recovered isolation text. name/team_name/mode are offered only with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS, matching the recovered hmt/CKn projection (!_o() strips them). pi validates against the offered schema, so a model sending name without teams gets a validation error; internal callers can still set name via tool_call rewrite.
run_in_background dropped when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS or CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT is truthy; disabled background also forces foreground execution.
All seven tiers are wired: built-in, plugin (pi packages plus runtime registrations), user, additional-directory project, current project, --agents flag, managed policy.
Current-project dirs are gathered from cwd up to the git root (home excluded) and sorted by baseDir depth like HX, so the deepest directory wins; additional-directory projects precede them.
Reload (session_start), resources_discover and runtime (un)registration clear the definition cache.
Built-ins skipped, active location first, ' — active: <path>' only when one is active, groups sorted by type. Still delivered as pstack:subagent-log events.
CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE yields built-ins only. pi has no --safe-mode flag; the env var is the recovered switch.
Colors of active agents (and the requested alias on normalization) are published as pstack:subagent-color for a UI consumer; pstack has no built-in renderer that paints them.
observeSubagents: false is retained like the recovered parser; other values are omitted.

Recovered wording for '-' names, ':' names, missing description, YAML errors ('YAML frontmatter in <path> failed to parse and was ignored'), thrown errors ('Error parsing agent from') and the 'Failed to parse agent from <path>: <reason>' line; nameless files are skipped silently.
Loads <managed>/.claude/agents as policySettings from the Claude Code managed path per OS; PI_MANAGED_DIR overrides the root (pi has no managed-settings location of its own).

pi has no --add-dir; pstack registers --add-dir (path-delimiter separated) and reads pstack.additionalDirectories. fromAdditionalDirectory provenance recorded. Child sessions see the setting but not the flag.
Installed pi packages contribute agents from agents/ or package.json pi.agents; names are <package>:<subdir...>:<agent> with the npm scope dropped.
Basename fallback and 'Agent from <plugin> plugin' description fallback (description, when_to_use, when-to-use).
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (and ${PI_PACKAGE_ROOT}) interpolate the package root. ${user_config.*} is not interpolated: pi packages have no per-plugin user configuration store.
Plugin files over 1 MiB or not regular are skipped with 'Skipping plugin agent ...'; local files with 'loadMarkdownFilesFromDir: skipping ...'. Symlinked regular files load.
permissionMode/hooks/mcpServers ignored with the recovered warning; only isolation worktree is kept.

pi.events 'pstack:register-agent' {plugin,name,spec,load?} and 'pstack:unregister-agent' {plugin,name}; entries are source plugin, registeredAtRunTime, placed after file plugin agents. Registrations live in the registering session; child sessions do not inherit them.
A lazy load must return the offered agentType and plugin source, else "Agent type '<type>' could not be loaded from its plugin.". The admission slot is reserved before the load.

Added claude-code-guide (outside sdk-* entrypoints, pointed at pi docs) and web-fetch (CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_FETCH_AGENT, not simple, not DISABLE_WEB_FETCH; always local). Blocked: the CLAUDE agent and coordinator-mode agents live in bundle chunks not in the evidence (chunk-b34nfmx9, chunk-tptjksm5), so their definitions cannot be reconstructed; the fork built-in belongs to the fork lane.
Agent stays offered under Agent(Plan)-style scopes; an omitted type is refused with the recovered missing-type message.

--max-budget-usd against the session's recorded cost (assistant, tool-result, usage and summary entries, which include foreground child usage). Exact recovered message. Children do not inherit the flag, and background child cost counts only once recorded in the parent session.
NFKC + lowercase + strip White_Space, Pd and underscore.

Compared against all active agents; unavailable candidates marked '(unavailable)'; 'Use the exact name: A or B' or 'None of these are available. Available agents: ...'. A single unavailable match is not found.
pstack.bypassSubagentConcurrencyCap is the config-gate analog. The eligible-model bypass (ultracode main-loop model) has no pi equivalent and is not modelled.

Built-in Explore resolves to inheritCap opus (recovered Uie): a parent above Opus runs Explore on the newest Opus of its provider; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_INHERIT_CAP disables it; under FORCE with an inherit default the cap is preserved.

CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_MODE with CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_FORCE_WORKER_INHERIT_MODEL discards the tool model, and the offered model field carries the recovered coordinator notes. Coordinator built-in agents remain unavailable (see A67).
Family stepping prefers the parent's provider, then its inference-profile prefix (us./eu./none), and an Opus pick takes the [1m] variant when the parent runs one.

Integer effort is read as a thinking-token budget and mapped to the smallest pi level whose default budget covers it (0 off, <=1024 minimal, <=2048 low, <=8192 medium, <=16384 high, else xhigh), then clamped to the model. Env still overrides the definition (precedence unverified in evidence).
